> One-paragraph human summary of where the project is and what to do next.

## Stage Reference

| Stage | Defining artefacts | Typical exit gate |
|-------|---------------------|-------------------|
| Concept | brainstorm note, persona drafts | Approved game/app concept doc + first PRD draft |
| Pre-production | PRDs, ADRs, traceability matrix, art/UX direction | Architecture review PASS |
| Production | sprints, stories, test plans, regular builds | Beta-ready feature complete |
| Polish | bug-triage, perf-profile, soak-test, a11y audits | Release-checklist all green |
| Release | release-checklist, store listings, rollout monitoring | Public launch |
| Live-Ops | telemetry-driven changes, season/event docs | Continuous |
